nameOrigin: an ancient, mythical metal (‘Lucario’ is the Japanese syllables reversed)

pokedexEntries.di: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

pokedexEntries.prl: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

pokedexEntries.pt: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

pokedexEntries.bw: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.x: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

pokedexEntries.or: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

pokedexEntries.y: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.as: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.su: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

pokedexEntries.mo: They can detect the species of a living being— and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

pokedexEntries.us: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

pokedexEntries.um: Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

pokedexEntries.sw: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

pokedexEntries.sh: It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainers who have justice in their hearts can earn this Pokémon’s trust.

pokedexEntries.bd: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

pokedexEntries.shp: By sensing the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

pokedexEntries.la: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name “aura” to this power.

pokedexEntries.sc: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

pokedexEntries.vi: A well-trained one can use its aura to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

pokedexEntries.za: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
